[[File:Tecu salamander detail.png|left|130px]]
The '''tecu salamander''' is the strongest [[salamander]] that can be caught using a [[net trap]] and the [[Hunter]] skill at level 79, granting 344 Hunter [[experience]], which can be found south-east of [[Ralos' Rise]]. Catching a matured tecu salamander is rare, as players often receive [[immature tecu salamander]]s instead; when an adult is captured, a message in the game chat will state {{mes|The salamander is fully grown, you could use this as a weapon}}{{sic|No period at the end.}}.

Tecu salamanders require level 80 [[Attack]], [[Magic]], and [[Ranged]] to wield. [[Irit tar]] is used as ammunition for the salamander. It is the best salamander to use for the two salamander-required [[Combat Achievements]]: [[The Worst Ranged Weapon]] and [[More than just a ranged weapon]]. 

Despite being able to perform Magic and Ranged attacks, this weapon requires the user to be in the opponent's [[melee]] distance to attack, potentially reducing the practicality of the two attack styles. However, it can be used to attack enemies from behind fences, and can also attack enemies in diagonal squares, meaning that [[safespot]]ting is still possible.

When using the Scorch (Slash) and Blaze (Magic) attack styles, the attack speed is 5. When using the Flare (Range) attack style, the attack speed is 4, which is similar in concept to the Rapid style of most ranged weapons, and it will use standard{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://x.com/JagexAsh/status/1812764898239107397?t=0cPxrFVCvgFX01UUhSnWsg|date=15 July 2024|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/27963964|archivedate=2 May 2026|quote="standard"|notes=|name=|group=}} ranged defence, similar to [[bows]].

'''Warning:''' This is a live creature; if [[Protect Item|unprotected]] it will run away when you [[Death|die]]. Should this happen, you will need to buy or catch a new one.

==Chance to hit==
Each attack style uses its own respective attack bonus (Slash, Range, Magic) when calculating a [[successful hit]]. Players looking to use two or more attack styles should take care in selecting equipment that does not penalize those attack bonuses.

==Maximum hit==
For melee mode the strength bonus of the salamander is used, which is 91 (nearly the same as a [[leaf-bladed battleaxe]]).

For ranged mode the ranged strength bonus of the tar is used to decide the maximum hit. The tecu salamander uses [[irit tar]]s which have a ranged strength bonus of 60 (same as [[Dragon arrow|dragon arrows]]).

The maximum hit for magic mode uses the "magic damage bonus" of the salamander. This bonus is not visible in the equipment stats, but is equal to 104 for the tecu salamander. Damage boosting items such as the [[Slayer helmet (i)]] and [[occult necklace]] can be used to increase the max hit.

The max hit (Hit<sub>max</sub>) formula for salamanders is as shown in fig.1, where "Magic" is your visible magic level and "Bonus" is the "magic strength bonus" for the salamander, in this case 104. This gives us the formula for the tecu salamander as shown in fig.2.

<math>\begin{align}
\text{Hit}_\text{max} &= \lfloor \frac{1}{2} + \frac{\text{Magic} \times (64 + \text{Bonus})}{640} \rfloor && (1) \\
\text{Hit}_\text{max} &= \lfloor \frac{1}{2} + \frac{\text{Magic} \times 168}{640} \rfloor && (2)
\end{align}</math>

The table below shows maximum hits from level 80 to level 125. Like all other magic attacks, the max hit damage can be increased by using [[magic damage]] boosting equipment.

==Trivia==
* Salamanders have a unique sound when equipping them.
* The tecu salamander may be named after the {{WP|Tegu|tegu lizard}}, which are large reptiles native to south and central America, regions which Varlamore draws many inspirations from.
* The design for the tecu salamander was inspired by the {{WP|Common collared lizard|eastern collared lizard}}.
